research_insights.selection_rationale: Non-intermittent, approximately normal demand with moderate CV (0.32) and a fixed MOQ make a continuous-review (r,Q) policy the natural fit. The normal combined-variance formula provides a closed-form safety stock without over-engineering.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap binds hard — unconstrained EOQ (16,481) is ~2.7x the available capacity headroom (5,918). If demand recovers upward, the capped order quantity will increase replenishment frequency and ordering costs significantly.
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — MOQ (3811) + Safety Stock (824) = 4635 < max_storage (6742). Policy is feasible.
